name: Klassen
description: Norwegian tv show about a class. Brings up a lot of different problems that pupils face on a day to day basis. Every character represents a different kind of person.

videos.title: New in Class
videos.overview: Herman is the newest guy in class, and we meet the gang for the first time.

videos.title: Group Picture
videos.overview: Amalie and the gang wants the perfect group photo, but does the picture show something that make Amalie angsty?

videos.title: Lazy Mathias
videos.overview: Ingrid and Mathias has a group project. Will Mathias even help with the project?

videos.title: Older Boyfriend
videos.overview: Astrid thinks the rest of the class is too childish. She thinks she's more mature then the rest and now has an older boyfriend.

videos.title: Something Going On
videos.overview: Today is a field day, while Herman pushes the same suspicion as Amalie, that something is going on between Mathias and Olivia.

videos.title: Adrian's Date
videos.overview: Adrian has been nominated to the Goldenclip, and arranges a competition where the prize is to join him at the award show. Herman sees this as a perfect time for a prank.

videos.title: Don't Caress
videos.overview: Mario and some of the boys challenge each other to who can touch most of the girls butts. Would everyone find this funny?

videos.title: The Evaluation
videos.overview: Joffe has an appointment with his teacher, Jacob. He's very nervous about it, and tries everything to get the appointment pushed back.

videos.title: The Boyfriend Thief, Part 1
videos.overview: Olivia admits to Amalia that she has a crush on Mathias. A rumor starts about Olivia being a boyfriend thief.

videos.title: The Boyfriend Thief, Part 2
videos.overview: Will Olivia and Amalie ever be friends again? And what is going on between Mathias and Olivia?

videos.title: Herman's Secret
videos.overview: Adrian finds out about Hermans secret, and threatens to tell it to everyone in class unless Herman starts acting nicer to everyone.

videos.title: Not for Sale
videos.overview: Ingrid's stepmom gives her lots of expensive stuff. Ingrid feels bad about her own mother, and doesn't want any of the items. She gives Joffe her new headphones.

videos.title: The First Kiss
videos.overview: Joffe and Astrid are going home to her, and he sees the possibility of getting his first kiss. Maybe Mathias could help him prepare?

videos.title: The Lie
videos.overview: Herman's birthday is today, but he doesn't want a party. Should he tell anyone?

videos.title: Copycat
videos.overview: Lily comes to school with the same sweater as Amalie. Amalie do NOT like that, and tells her to put on something else.

videos.title: Class Treasury
videos.overview: The class is having a class trip but not everyone have paid in to the treasury. Can everyone afford to join the trip?

videos.title: A New Couple
videos.overview: Ada sees the possibility of setting up Mathias and Olivia, but not everything is that easily done.

videos.title: Please, Hermann
videos.overview: Herman has an exclusive lotion that makes his skin perfectly smooth. Amalie does everything she can to get her hands on that lotion.

videos.title: The Boy Test
videos.overview: Amalie and the girls tries a new method to find the perfect boy. They make a test.

videos.title: Cake War
videos.overview: There is a baking competition in home economics class. How is the friendship between Amalie and Olivia going?

videos.title: The Truth About Amalie
videos.overview: Amalie has forgotten her phone at home, and her mom tells her she can bring it to school. Amalie really doesn't want her mom to come to school.

videos.title: Broken Promises
videos.overview: Mathias keeps on breaking his appointments with Olivia. Will the relationship survive?

videos.title: The First Period
videos.overview: Astrid has just gotten her period, and finds it embarrassing. But is it really that embarrassing when half the population gets it?

videos.title: The Mobile Thief, Part 1
videos.overview: Amalie, Lily and Sara finds Fie's cellphone. They look through her pictures and videos, and finds something they probably shouldn't have seen.

videos.title: The Mobile Thief, Part 2
videos.overview: Did Amalie go too far? And will she make it up to Fie?

videos.title: The Nerd and the Bitch
videos.overview: Amalie and Adrian has a group project about prejudices.

videos.title: The Queen of the Class
videos.overview: Amalie's position as the class queen is threatened. Lily tries a mutiny for the throne.

videos.title: One Month Anniversary
videos.overview: Mathias and Olivia has been together for one month. Have Mathias forgotten their anniversary?

videos.title: Football Player
videos.overview: Ida is tiered of being seen as a tomboy. She decides to do something about it.

videos.title: The Petition
videos.overview: Ingrid tries to get people to join her petition for a campaign, and gets help from Ada.

videos.title: Did You Pee Yourself?
videos.overview: What do you do when an accident happens at school? Amalie gets some surprising help from Joffe.

videos.title: Fie Needs Comfort
videos.overview: Fie's mother has died. The class decides to make a video greeting card to cheer her up, but Joffe doesn't want to.

videos.title: Lily's Fear
videos.overview: Lily has to do a presentation in front of class, but she doesn't want to. She's afraid she will embarrass her self in front of Noah.

videos.title: Joffe's Crush
videos.overview: Joffe has a crush on Amalie. Will he manage to seduce her?

videos.title: Dreaming of Becoming Famous
videos.overview: Ada and Ida registered to enter a new talent show by NRK. They ask Adrian to film their audition tape.

videos.title: The Three Hottest
videos.overview: Amalie and the girls makes a list about the three most handsome guys at school.

videos.title: Does She Have Anorexia?
videos.overview: Ingrid sews in some clothes. Fie and Olivia tries to find out if Ingrid has anorexia.

videos.title: The Massive Pimple
videos.overview: Mario has a massive pimple!

videos.title: Embarrassed About Mom
videos.overview: Joffe's mom is the new janitor at school.

videos.title: Ingrid Skips Class
videos.overview: Ingrid skips school to pierce her ears. Her mom finds out about it.

videos.title: Only Girl in the World
videos.overview: Ada has two tickets to a Rihanna concert. Lara and Casper does everything they can to get her to pick one of them to join her.

videos.title: The Rumor
videos.overview: Amalie and Victoria creates a rumor that the new girl Hedvig is loose. Is it Hedvig that's with Mathias in the toilet.

videos.title: Guy Friends
videos.overview: Ada and Mario is best friends. But can a girl and a boy just be friends?

videos.title: The Theft, Part 1
videos.overview: Amalie and Olivia each buys a new sweater. But both aren't paid for. One is stolen, and the store owner and the security guard visits the school.

videos.title: The Theft, Part 2
videos.overview: Amalie gets blamed for stealing the sweater. Will Olivia tell the truth?

videos.title: Embarrassing Pictures
videos.overview: Ada tries to share some embarrassing pictures with Mario, but ends up with posting it on the intranet so the whole school can see them. She needs to get some help from Adrian before it's too late.

videos.title: Calm Down, Noah
videos.overview: Noah gets jealous, and doesn't like how the other boys are acting towards Lily.

videos.title: Sneaky Picture
videos.overview: Victoria and Sara takes a picture of Ingrid while she changes clothes in the locker room. Ingrid sees it and tells them to delete it. They vehemently deny that they've done anything.

videos.title: Together or Not, Part 1
videos.overview: Olivia believes that she sees Mathias kissing Amalie. Do they need time apart?

videos.title: Together or Not, Part 2
videos.overview: One of the older boys contacts Olivia. Maybe he's better for her than Mathias?

videos.title: Sports Nerds
videos.overview: Amalie ends up on the team of the sporty girls, and Adrian in gym class.

videos.title: Class Party
videos.overview: The class is going to have a party, but first they need to clean up after someone has vandalized the wood shop room.

videos.title: Truth or Dare, Part 1
videos.overview: Ada likes Casper and he is surprised when she asks if he wants to be her boyfriend. Without thinking, he says yes. But while playing a game of "truth or dare", Casper is challenged to kiss Sara

videos.title: Truth or Dare, Part 2
videos.overview: Something is going on between Sara and Casper. But then Sara misunderstands and thinks Casper likes Victoria.

videos.title: Old Friends
videos.overview: Jeppe is new to the class and knows no one but Adrian. But he soon realizes that Adrian is the nerd in the class.

videos.title: Red Wine
videos.overview: Ida's big sister Julie has stolen a bottle of wine at home and Ida has gossiped to her parents. Now, Julie is mad at Ida and demands that she get a new bottle. Ingrid comes to Ida's rescue.

videos.title: YouTube Star
videos.overview: Ada imagines that she might become popular if she became a celebrity on YouTube.

videos.title: Horse Girls
videos.overview: Lily usually rides with Tiril, but gets teased by Amalie and the other girls. Lily, who wants to keep her place in the gang, starts bullying Tiril.

videos.title: Win at Any Cost
videos.overview: Mathias and Markus argue about which one of them is the best trained. Nico suggests that they can figure it out by creating their own "Master of the Masters" in the schoolyard.

videos.title: Romeo and Juliet
videos.overview: Joffe goes to audition for the school's new play Romeo and Julia, but soon discovers that some of the boys in the class think it's not cool. He tries to hide it, but gets a problem when he actually gets the lead.

videos.title: Lily's Diary
videos.overview: Lily is out of the girl gang with Amalie. In the diary, Lily writes that she feels lonely, abandoned. One day she loses her diary in the school yard.

videos.title: A True Friend
videos.overview: Mario ditches Adrian when they get into trouble. Repeatedly. Adrian gets mad, and when Mario tries to prove to Adrian that he is actually a good friend it gets even worse.

videos.title: The Divorce
videos.overview: Astrid's parents are going to divorce. Astrid is a great athlete and would rather pretend to be nothing at school .. but things are not going well.

videos.title: Sex and Relationships
videos.overview: Olivia and Mathias go to school together but arrive late. The class has sex education for the first time and suspects that something "juicy" has happened between the couple when they arrive too late.

videos.title: Noah's Work Week
videos.overview: It's job week for the class. Noah's father has fixed the best job for him, and Noah is boasting to the class. But eventually it turns out that he has no job after all. What is he doing now?

videos.title: Joffe and Madelen, Part 1
videos.overview: Joffe has become popular after attending the school theater. Girls who have never noticed him are getting interested. Joffe has started to like Madelen, but is she really interested in him?

videos.title: Joffe and Madelen, Part 2
videos.overview: What was going on between Joffe and Madelen is disturbed by Victoria and Amalie. Just because Victoria is also interested in Joffe.

videos.title: Girls on the Football Team
videos.overview: Astrid, was going to try on the school team in football. Mathias and the other boys will decide who may join and who may not.

videos.title: The Boys' Locker Room
videos.overview: Kasper hates to shower with the others after gym. He tends to wash himself in the toilet, but some start to wonder why he is not showering.

videos.title: Ada's Boyfriend
videos.overview: Ada thinks it's smart to never have a boyfriend. Then she gets an idea.

videos.title: Friendless Lily
videos.overview: The class is divided into groups of two, but Lily has no one to be with.

videos.title: Kissing with Braces
videos.overview: Fie likes a boy with braces. But she is afraid to kiss him. Imagine if they get stuck in each other's braces

videos.title: Running Away From Home
videos.overview: Ingrid does not understand why Lara is acting so strange. When she discovers that Lara is planning to sleep at school, she confronts her.

videos.title: What Happens Now?
videos.overview: Olivia and Mathias start to argue and quarrel. What happens now?

videos.title: Ingrid Is in Love
videos.overview: Rumor has it that Ingrid and Herman have something going on. Ingrid is scared that Herman will misunderstand, and tells him something she has been thinking about for a long time but has not told anyone.

videos.title: The Hunt for Likes
videos.overview: Bella is completely obsessed with the likes of Instagram and uses her mobile phone all the time. Sara is tired of spending more time on her mobile phone than with her real friends. Then Sara has finally had enough.

videos.title: Football Trouble
videos.overview: Mathias's dad, Martin, is the coach of the school football team. Unfortunately, he is strict with Mathias, who feels very pressured.

videos.title: Best Friends?
videos.overview: Ada says yes to going on a date with Mark, a fellow student in the parallel class, but later regrets it a bit.

videos.title: The Rivals
videos.overview: The best friends Mathias and Noah are both in love with Madelen. When they realize they are competing for the same girl, they get an idea.

videos.title: Amalie's New Bestie
videos.overview: Amalie asks Madelen for tips to get Jeppe interested. Madelen sees an opportunity to take over Amalie's role as a leader in the class by becoming best friends with her.

videos.title: Herman Moves Away
videos.overview: Ingrid goes no further with her love for Siri. She is seeking support from her best friend Herman. Unfortunately, he has bad news.

videos.title: The Jewelry Thief
videos.overview: Victoria plans to buy a piece of jewelry and shares a photo of it on insta and gets many likes. The next day, Amalie shows up with a completely identical piece of jewelry.

videos.title: Friendless Edvard
videos.overview: Edvard has no friends and tries to attract Noah and Mathias by boasting their cool stuff. Mathias is on to him though.

videos.title: The Fart
videos.overview: It suddenly starts to smell of a fart. The boys blame the girls and the girls blame the boys. Who was it?

videos.title: The Cheater
videos.overview: Herman realizes that he didn't prepare the correct homework before the chemistry test. Now he is stressed and plans to cheat. Only top marks count.

videos.title: The Fish in the Bag
videos.overview: Victoria feels that she doesn't belong in the girl gang and that Madelen is trying to get Amalie for herself.

videos.title: Are We on the Same Team, Part 1
videos.overview: Both Mathias and Noah are late to the football game with the school team. But only Mathias gets shut up by the coach who is also Mathias' dad.

videos.title: Embarrassing Interests
videos.overview: Victoria plays the violin, but is a little embarrassed by it. Mathias quickly notices that Victoria plays the violin and conceals it. He knows everything about parents who push kids too much.

videos.title: The King of Truancy
videos.overview: Students should write articles about how the school used to be in the past. Ada gets an idea and they find an article about their teacher from when he was a student himself. It's going to be totally epic.

videos.title: Nude Photos, Part 1
videos.overview: During a school party, Madelen and Jeppe sit together. Amalie doesn't like it, something Victoria gets along with. Victoria would like to befriend Amalie again, and when Jeppe forgets his cellphone on the sofa, Victoria takes it.

videos.title: Nude Photos, Part 2
videos.overview: Victoria is not an important part of the girl gang anymore and has hatched a plan to get into it again. But it does not go as she intended.

videos.title: Are We on the Same Team, Part 2
videos.overview: Mathias and Noah have been enemies since the last school fight. Now it's time for another fight, but they haven't budged. The quarrel is picking up again.

videos.title: Never Invisible Again
videos.overview: Tiril is tired of feeling invisible. She has a plan that will probably make her less overlooked.

videos.title: The Heart in the Girls' Room
videos.overview: Adrian wants a girlfriend. He brings Edvard with him and together they hatch a plan. Against all odds, it actually works.

videos.title: Leave Me Alone, Part 1
videos.overview: Jeppe has been liking Madelen for a long time and has been completely mesmerized by her. On the way to greet her, he happens to look at her cellphone and find out that her father is in the hospital. Madelen will not talk about it and their entire friendship will be compromised.

videos.title: Leave Me Alone, Part 2
videos.overview: Jeppe and Madelen have agreed to train before school starts. But when he gets there she trains with Mathias. Jeppe is very disappointed.

videos.title: Who Stinks?
videos.overview: Ida struggles with the smell of sweat all the time. She panics when Edvard suspects that she's the one who stinks in the classroom.

videos.title: Like a Horror Movie
videos.overview: It's Ingrid's birthday! But on the way to school she is called by a sickly nasty voice on the phone. She has no idea who it is, and gets scared.

videos.title: Drama-Free Zone
videos.overview: Amalie has traveled to Paris, but is afraid that Bella and Sara will become better friends while she is away, and that she will not remain the queen of the gang. She decides to create some drama all the way from Paris.

videos.title: The Struggle for Power
videos.overview: The student council needs a representative from the class. Ingrid is of course the only one who expresses her interest, but suddenly she gets competition from Mathias.

videos.title: The New Old Flame
videos.overview: Adrian turns out to be the person Amalie has talked about on a website. When he tells that it is he to Amalie, she panics.

videos.title: Boys Are the Worst
videos.overview: Lily has a crush on Chris, one of the older boys at school. But Joffe and Oda overhear Chris say he only wants to be with Lily because she's pretty.

videos.title: Love Is in the Air
videos.overview: Jeppe is tired of everything at school being about being good at sports. The downfall is that the boys in the class bully him when he plays volleyball. Madelen gets it, and becomes the one who comforts him.

videos.title: The Graduation
videos.overview: It is the last day before the summer holidays and class teacher Jacob has to run out to stop a fight. What he does not know is that the fight is just a diversion.

videos.title: Drama on the First Day of School, Part 1
videos.overview: Already on the first day of school, there will be drama in the class. A new boy starts in the class and something is stolen.

videos.title: Drama on the First Day of School, Part 2
videos.overview: Amalie has a nice conversation that means a lot to her and the class finds out what happened to her mobile phone.

videos.title: Cheese Puffs and Game Night
videos.overview: The girl group in the class is invited to a game night, that gets an unexpected end.

videos.title: An Idiotic Bet
videos.overview: Ada and Mario make a competition, which means that the loser must do something really embarrassing in the Class.

videos.title: See me
videos.overview: Ida gets mad at her father because he asks Noah to join them, in their first Champions League match. Is he not happy to have a daughter?

videos.title: The Climate Lie
videos.overview: Emrik tries to use Ingerid's climate action, "Plastic in the sea", as a hidden agenda for a crush.

videos.title: A Cunning Plan
videos.overview: Amalie and Bella each have their own plan with Philip and there will be a fight.

videos.title: Noah's Choice
videos.overview: Noah has a secret dream. Does he dare to follow it?

videos.title: Escaperoom
videos.overview: Adrian makes an intelligence test in an Escaperoom for Kasper, Ada, Joffe and Sebastian. They love it, but something unexpected happens when they are up and running.

videos.title: The Cursed Mask
videos.overview: Ada is very fascinated by everything that is mysterious. She decides to put on a cursed mask in class.

videos.title: The Sweatband
videos.overview: It smells like sweat from Kasper's headband after a dance battle. Aliyah throws it away, but it turns out that this headband brings happiness to Kasper.

videos.title: The Peanut Stew
videos.overview: Philip impresses the girls with a peanut stew in food and health, Noah and Mathias become jealous and decide to ruin it for him.

videos.title: Little Joffe
videos.overview: Joffe feels bullied because of his height. But Ada has some clever tips.

videos.title: The Insta Challenge
videos.overview: Amalie is challenged in an instachallenge and must tell Philip that she is keen on him. He gets hurt when he finds out it was an instachallenge. The truth is, she really likes him.

videos.title: Tough Love
videos.overview: Edvard is a goalkeeper talent, and gets a lot of credit from the football boys in the class. But they are very harsh when they congratulate him, something Edvard thinks is a bit tiring.

videos.title: The Birthday Thief
videos.overview: Bella is tired of having a birthday on the same day as Sara, so she decides to trick her into having the birthday for herself.

videos.title: Drama at Home
videos.overview: Noah is having a hard time at home, and wants to hang out with Nico. But then Nico has to cancel the agreement with Ida, who he has a big crush on ...

videos.title: Herman Dahl Takes Over
videos.overview: Herman Dahl will visit the class! Sara is looking forward wildly, but panics when Ingrid spills water on the sweater just before he arrives.

videos.title: The Christmas Party
videos.overview: Lily has been given responsibility for arranging the class' Christmas party and wants to make it classic, but Victoria has got an idea that it will be a New Year's party.

videos.title: Joffe Laughs Last
videos.overview: Joffe has a crush on Lily, which she takes advantage of. Adrian does not understand that Joffe does not understand it. But Joffe has a plan!

videos.title: The Best Friend, Part 1
videos.overview: Alex, Amalie's new friend, knows Philip from before. She remembers him as a guy who tried hard. So now Amalie has to try to change Philip.

videos.title: The Best Friend, Part 2
videos.overview: Amalie and Philip become friends again, but she is convinced that Philip and Alex have a thing. She's trying to sabotage it.

videos.title: The Best Friend, Part 3
videos.overview: Amalie gets caught after sending fake messages to create a rift between Alex and Philip. Philip gets angry, and Amalie realizes that she has to make amends.

videos.title: The Strongest in Class
videos.overview: The strongest in the class is decided in an arm wrestling competition. Kasper has won every time, but now he gets a new competitor, Mathias.

videos.title: The Heirloom (Theme Days Special)
videos.overview: Fie does not want to stand out and therefore avoids saying that she is a Jew. Edvard believes that she should be proud of her background.

videos.title: Who Is Right? (Theme Days Special)
videos.overview: Aryan starts signing up for Bella because she believes in the creation story. It seems Lotte is a jerk, and she and Aryan are arguing about who is right.

videos.title: The Optimist (Theme Days Special)
videos.overview: Emrik and Joffe are in a group together in KRLE, and Emrik tests whether prayer can give them a good grade on the KRLE task. Joffe gets annoyed and wants Emrik to work rather than pray. The quarrel will have major consequences for both of them.

videos.title: Ida Is a Sore Loser
videos.overview: Ida is called a bad loser by several in the class, and to disprove this she loses the football match on purpose.

videos.title: The Only Single One
videos.overview: Lily does not want to be the only single in the girlfriend gang. She creates a rift between Olivia and Mathias because she is afraid they will get together again.

videos.overview:
Noah steals the teacher's cell phone. Mathias doesn't understand, and Noah refuses to explain it.

videos.overview: Mathias finds out why Noah stole a cell phone. Mathias was involved without knowing it. Noah turns out to be a good friend who was tricked.

videos.overview: Edvard pranks Hedvig and gets hit on the head.

videos.overview: Sara reveals Tiril's secret celebrity crush. Tiril has a secret on Sara, does she choose to share it in revenge?

videos.overview: Bella and Victoria cheat. When Lotte gossips, Victoria takes revenge.

videos.title: Humiliated, Part 2
videos.overview: Bella feels sorry for Lotte and reveals everything behind Victoria's back. Victoria is now taking revenge on Bella.

videos.overview: Jeppe thinks that Madelen is on the death list for the Russians. He gets into trouble with the Russian when he tries to help her.

videos.title: The Death List, Part 2
videos.overview: The Russian threatens to soak Jeppe in eggs and water. Jeppe dreads, but when it looks darkest he gets help from a surprising team ...

videos.title: Desperate for a Friend
videos.overview: The class' new football has been stolen. Mathias, Noah and Isak know that Philip has taken it, but the teacher does not believe them.

videos.title: Forbidden Love
videos.overview: Noah promises to help Nico stay with Ida, but after a chat with Ida he regrets the promise.

videos.title: The Alarm
videos.overview: Tiril goes too far in a prank, Emrik and Adrian can not believe that she actually did it. They just joked about it.

videos.title: Three on a Date, Part 1
videos.overview: Ida is going to a game with Nico, Nico thinks it's a date. Noah intervenes.

videos.title: Three on a Date, Part 2
videos.overview: Both Nico and Noah are going on a date with Ida. They fight for her attention, but Ida has other plans.

videos.title: Who is the Stalker? Part 1
videos.overview: Bella invents a stalker to get more likes on instagram. Everyone thinks there really is one in the class.

videos.title: Too Close
videos.overview: Ada and Madelen have become good friends but Madelen struggles with Ada being so cuddly. Madelen invents a story to escape the cuddling.

videos.title: Tampon Trouble
videos.overview: Amalie loses all her tampons across the floor. She gets embarrassed when everyone laughs at her. Adrian tries to help her!

videos.title: Who is the Stalker? Part 2
videos.overview: More and more people think that Joffe is the stalker. Bella has to make a choice.

videos.title: Two Boyfriends
videos.overview: Both Nico and Noah think they are with Ida. Ida puts them in their place.

videos.title: Stuck in the Middle
videos.overview: Olivia ends up in the middle of a conflict between Sara and Victoria. To escape, she reveals the secrets of both.

videos.title: Together
videos.overview: Noah wants to be a good friend, and lets Nico impress Ida so he can stay with her. Ida ends up kissing someone.

videos.title: Mommy's Boy
videos.overview: Mario has promised his mother to stay out of trouble, but struggles when Joffe wants them to wander. A misunderstanding makes the boys enemies.

videos.title: The Instagram Theft
videos.overview: Bella is big on insta and becomes popular at school. Someone in the class steals her insta identity.

videos.title: Secret Crush, Part 1
videos.overview: Olivia wants Mathias to help her stay with the skate boy, Oscar. But Mathias has a secret crush that makes him not want to ...

videos.title: Secret Crush, Part 2
videos.overview: Olivia arranges a date on a skate ramp that is far too dangerous for beginners. Mathias has to decide whether to help her or not.

videos.title: Absolutely Perfect
videos.overview: Amalie stresses to make the perfect party. She gets furious when Edvard calls her a bitch, and decides to take revenge on Edvard.

videos.title: Party in Danger
videos.overview: The class is against Amalie for what she did to Edvard. The girls try to fix it, but Adrian sees through it.

videos.title: The Queen's Escape
videos.overview: The party is perfect, but Amalie can not stop thinking about something that has happened. She leaves her own party to save the situation.

videos.title: The Dream Job
videos.overview: Olivia wants to be a reporter but ends up bossing everyone she interviews. Tiril to the rescue.

videos.title: Crisis on the Last Day of School
videos.overview: Everyone in the class must perform one last school assignment. Olivia's dream of making a film is shattered, and she decides not to submit it anyway.

videos.title: The Class – School Camp: Welcome
videos.overview: The class is going to summer camp, and is very excited about it. Kasper and Sara is planning to sneak away from the others, while Lily meets an old crush.

videos.title: The Class – School Camp: The Rebus
videos.overview: The teacher has created a rebus. Mathias is not happy about being put on the same team as Amalie, and an old fight comes back to the surface.

videos.title: The Class – School Camp: Ghost Stories

videos.title: A Complete Disaster, Part 2
videos.overview: The shock announcement from the teacher divides the group, and a clever plan is put into action to save the school year.

videos.title: The New Ones
videos.overview: Kris and Chani are new at school and trying to find their way around. Little do they know that someone is out to get them.

videos.title: Alpha Male
videos.overview: Edvard has ruled the schoolyard for a long time, but when new boy Martin shows up full of confidence, his position is put to the test.

videos.title: Bathroom Smoke
videos.overview: A disgusting smell saves Rasmus from his science test, but at what cost?

videos.title: Not Invited
videos.overview: Truls and August are best friends, but what happens to their friendship when August is suddenly accepted by Hans and the "cool" guys?

videos.title: I Don’t Want To Anymore
videos.overview: Truls learns a lie that puts August's friendship to the test.

videos.title: Recognize You
videos.overview: Elsa's secret can't be shared with anyone, especially not Vanessa. Martin makes it difficult to keep it hidden.

videos.title: Sick Diva
videos.overview: Kris feels alone when Chani isn't at school. Edvard takes her in, but not everyone seems happy about it.

videos.title: The Class Photo
videos.overview: Can a class photo bring the class together and make everyone finally friends?

videos.title: Just use AI
videos.overview: Liam and August get to test both their friendship and sense of justice when they use AI - because if you're in the game, you have to take the heat.

videos.title: Our Turn
videos.overview: The boys always get to choose their sport in the gym. Petra thinks it's the girls' turn.

videos.title: A New Friend?
videos.overview: Samuel thinks the new girl is cool, but messes things up when he tries to mess with her.

videos.title: Dyslexia?
videos.overview: Vanessa tells Elsa an embarrassing secret. It has consequences - both for Vanessa and the friendship.

videos.title: Count to Ten
videos.overview: Chani's anger is put to the test when the class has a packing game in class.

videos.title: The Surprise
videos.overview: It's Saga's birthday, but she sees no reason to celebrate. She's disappointed with a grade and her friend Samuel is behaving strangely.

videos.title: Who Is She?
videos.overview: Amani doesn't dare say he has feelings for a girl he plays with online. Mathilda helps him with a plan that has surprising results. For both of them.

videos.title: Disco Queen
videos.overview: There will be a dance audition for a music video, but Kris is unsure whether cheerleading will impress the choreographer.

videos.title: Revenge
videos.overview: Hans puts on his most expensive clothes to impress "The Secret Society" - the club for the coolest kids in school. It gets noticed, and Hans makes an enemy.

videos.title: Can You Make Out?
videos.overview: Mathilda is stressed by the thought that everyone else has more kissing experience than her. Is there someone she might want to kiss?

videos.title: Broke as Hell
videos.overview: August is very excited about being selected for the county team. Edvard comments on his worn and holey soccer shoes and he becomes uncertain.

videos.title: The School's Prettiest
videos.overview: A list of who is the prettiest in school goes viral, and it seems the girls' fate is in someone's hands.

videos.title: The Secret Society
videos.overview: Hans is determined to get into the Secret Society - but first he must solve a difficult riddle.

videos.title: Out Late
videos.overview: Rasmus feels he has a little "swag" and gets to test both his muscles and new style.

videos.title: The Lie
videos.overview: Elsa is struggling to keep the lie she has kept hidden for so long from Vanessa and the girls. Can she really tell the truth after all this time?

videos.title: Is It Us?
videos.overview: Vanessa feels Edvard is wavering in the relationship. Things don't get any better when Kris makes a move on Edvard. An anonymous snap with a shocking photo changes everything.

videos.title: More Sexy
videos.overview: A shocking Snapchat photo and a dance rehearsal with choreographer Nico put Kris in an uncomfortable situation.

videos.title: Every Other Week
videos.overview: When Chani and Truls want to take Ulrik out skating, he disappears without a trace.

videos.title: Is It You? Part 1
videos.overview: Mathilda is in love with Amani, but he's only interested in the girl he plays with online. She has said that they can meet.

videos.title: Is It You? Part 2
videos.overview: Amani is still looking for the girl he's in love with. Mathilda is getting bored. She's in love with him, but how can she say it so he actually sees her?

videos.title: I like you!
videos.overview: Chani is angrier than usual and Kris is worried. Can she find out why? Ulrik likes Chani to be himself, but can he be as honest?

videos.title: First mission
videos.overview: Hans receives an assignment from "The Secret Society". How far is he willing to go?

videos.title: Revealed
videos.overview: Elsa is trying to juggle her feelings for Martin, her friendship with Vanessa and the big lie she's been hiding.

videos.title: Blood sisters
videos.overview: Petra gets her period and struggles to deal with the emotions surrounding it. On top of that, Maggie and Elida are behaving so strangely.

videos.title: The two of us forever!
videos.overview: As Kris and Chani's friendship unravels, Martin suggests that the girls resolve the conflict on the basketball court - in a basketball duel.

videos.title: Skins - part 1
videos.overview: Amani puts skins, money and his relationship with Mathilda on the line when he gambles online.

videos.title: Skins - part 2
videos.overview: A professional CS player puts Amani's mind at ease, but can he get out of all the trouble he's in?

videos.title: The date
videos.overview: Elida and Rasmus have a challenge for Maggie. Even an innocent joke can hurt. Have they gone too far?

videos.title: The Fall
videos.overview: When an uninvited guest shows up at Vanessa's party, a fight breaks out, and old friends become enemies.

videos.title: Makeup Press
videos.overview: Sometimes it's hard to know who you are. Naima does Petra's makeup, but it doesn't turn out quite the way Petra had imagined.

videos.title: A knife in the back
videos.overview: The mood among the girls is tense. Elsa and Vanessa are forced to work together in Norwegian class. Maybe the solution is to pretend to be someone else?

videos.title: Hair on the chest
videos.overview: Ulrik goes to extreme lengths to hide the fact that he's the only one with chest hair.

videos.title: Doesn't anyone care?
videos.overview: Naima is leaving for London soon to take dance classes all summer. Is no one really going to say goodbye?

videos.title: Why are you bothering me?
videos.overview: Hans gets a new assignment from The Secret Society. He has to hang out with Saga!

videos.title: A Friend in Need
videos.overview: Elida and Rasmus are annoyed with Maggie for being late - but does she have a valid reason?

videos.title: I hate it
videos.overview: Liam finds it embarrassing to speak in front of the class - everyone else thinks it's easy. Or do they?

videos.title: Now I Get It - Part 1
videos.overview: To join "The Secret Society," Hans comes up with a wild plan.

videos.title: Now I Get It - Part 2
videos.overview: Finally, Hans is about to meet "The Secret Society." Is everything just as he had imagined?
